verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical, and both share the same flaws. The two decorative circles were moved from opposite corners into a stacked pair of blobs on the far left that is clipped by the canvas edge and reads as clutter. The CITRINE wordmark floats on its own, away from the product. 'SINGLE ORIGIN' on the bag is too small to read. The headline sits close to the right edge, and the CTA is not aligned to the headline's left edge or centred under it, so the banner's structure works but needs fixes before it ships.
